text:
maria: quick async shift snapshot — SLOs / alerts follow-ups

maria: what I did: triaged the overnight run-rate spike, found autoscaler missed due to mis-tagged instance group, pushed a small fix to tag detection and verified scaling now fires.

maria: blockers: still seeing high p95 generative latency in eu-west-1 (SLO drift). Suspect kernel mismatch on the quantized path, needs a kernel bump + rolling restart window.

maria: today: coordinate restart with infra, add runbook steps, follow up on alert noise tuning.

tony: can you drop the alert IDs? I'll take the restart calendar and coordinate the window. :thumbsup:

devon: alert IDs: SRE-ALRT-1123 (latency p95 > 2200ms) and SRE-ALRT-1124 (kv-cache miss spike). Traces show KV cache miss rate spikes around the int8 quant rollout.

devon: I'm spinning up a quick fallback to previous quant profile to validate. If that drops latency, we can roll back the rollout.

maria: @devon thx — can you open a quick PR and tag @jamie for canary verification? Also added a short note to the runbook (placeholder link: https://docs.internal/runbooks/slo-eu-west).

jamie: ack, I'll own the canary. Scheduling a 20m canary at 14:30 UTC. If canary shows p95 improvement > 15% we'll promote.

jamie: monitor query to watch during canary (adding to channel when scheduled):
```
sum(rate(requests_latency_bucket{le="0.95"}[1m])) by (model)
```

sre-bot: Deploy bot: tag-detection-fix v1.2.3 deployed to staging — smoke tests passed.

tony: oncall follow-ups: PD-987 was closed and routed to infra for a short postmortem. @maria can you add a note to the PM doc with the autoscaler tagging root cause?

maria: will add the note and include timeline. Also pinging security for KMS key rotation permission — we need a short window to rotate keys during restart. :eyes:

devon: if security takes time, we have a temporary fallback plan: serve affected traffic from the dedicated pool in the region (higher cost but stable). I'll draft the play.

jamie: action items summary: 1) PR for quant fallback (devon) 2) Canary @ 14:30 (jamie) 3) Restart window & tag restart (tony) 4) Postmortem note (maria) 5) KMS approval ping to security (maria) — please add reactions when done. :white_check_mark:

maria: adding status updates here as they land, thanks team. :raised_hands:
